name: company-claw-bridge
description: Tether Claude Desktop to your company's central OpenClaw assistant. Dispatch tasks, supervise from orbit, answer escalations. From Lunace Labs.
long_description: Lunace Tether is the line between Claude Desktop and your company's OpenClaw assistant. Claude dispatches tasks, polls progress, cancels runaways, inspects sessions, and answers escalations Claw raises with the [ASK-CLAUDE] marker. Transport is a shared company Telegram bot, so the same Claw can be reached from any employee's machine without exposing the Gateway to the public internet. Built by Lunace Labs.

telegram_bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_bot_token.description: Shared company bot token (from @BotFather). The plugin uses this to send messages to and receive messages from the company's OpenClaw assistant.

claw_chat_id.title: Claw chat ID
claw_chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID for your private chat with the company Claw bot. To find it: send /start to the bot, then visit https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates and copy the chat.id of your message.

audit_chat_id.title: Audit chat ID (dev mirror)
audit_chat_id.description: Optional. Telegram chat ID of a channel/group where every Claude<->Claw message will be mirrored when dev_mirror is on.

dev_mirror.title: Dev mirror enabled
dev_mirror.description: When on, copy every outbound and inbound message to the audit chat. Turn off in production.

default_timeout_ms.title: Default reply timeout (ms)
default_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Claw to reply to a dispatched task before giving up.

escalation_marker.title: Escalation marker
escalation_marker.description: String Claw prefixes a reply with when it wants Claude to help. Default is [ASK-CLAUDE].

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Directory used for the Telegram update_id watermark and pending-request log.

tools.name: claw_dispatch
tools.description: Send a task to the company's OpenClaw assistant and wait for the full reply. Returns Claw's final answer, or an escalation object if Claw asked Claude for help.

tools.name: claw_dispatch_async
tools.description: Send a task to Claw without waiting. Returns a request_id Claude can poll with claw_poll.

tools.name: claw_poll
tools.description: Return whatever Claw has produced so far for a previously-dispatched async task.

tools.name: claw_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight async task by request_id. Sends /reset to Claw if the task is currently being worked on.

tools.name: claw_status
tools.description: Run Claw's /status chat command and return the parsed response.

tools.name: claw_health
tools.description: Probe Claw with a no-op status query to confirm the Telegram round-trip works and Claw is responding.

tools.name: claw_list_sessions
tools.description: Call Claw's sessions_list tool and return its session list.

tools.name: claw_session_history
tools.description: Call Claw's sessions_history tool for a given session_id and optional limit.

tools.name: claw_send_to_session
tools.description: Call Claw's sessions_send tool to deliver a message to a specific Claw session.

tools.name: claw_set_verbosity
tools.description: Set Claw's verbose/trace/usage flags via /verbose, /trace, /usage chat commands.

tools.name: claw_compact
tools.description: Tell Claw to compact its current session context (/compact).

tools.name: claw_restart
tools.description: Ask Claw to restart its current session (/restart).

tools.name: claw_check_escalations
tools.description: Return any pending [ASK-CLAUDE] escalations Claw has raised but Claude has not yet answered.

tools.name: claw_answer_escalation
tools.description: Answer a specific escalation by escalation_id; posts [CLAUDE-REPLY:<id>] back into the Telegram thread so Claw can continue.
